pptx_slides.subtitle: Case for change and 90-day launch plan for the Executive Committee

pptx_slides.title: Manual work slows safety responses and executive decisions; a phased automation programme fixes both within a year
pptx_slides.subtitle: Executive summary

column_cards.heading: Situation
column_cards.body: Pharmacovigilance and MIS teams rely on manual intake, reconciliation and reporting across six disconnected systems.

column_cards.heading: Complication
column_cards.body: Serious cases take 18 days to process against a 7-day regulatory window; monthly MIS packs land 4 days after close.

column_cards.heading: Resolution
column_cards.body: Automate case intake and MIS consolidation in four phases, starting with a 90-day pilot that pays back in year one.
